name: alpha-methylacyl-CoA racemase

function.text: AMACR encodes alpha-methylacyl-CoA racemase. Annotated molecular activities include alpha-methylacyl-CoA racemase activity and signaling receptor binding. It participates in bile acid biosynthetic process and bile acid metabolic process.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to alpha-methylacyl-CoA racemase deficiency (autosomal recessive).
